capabilities: Chart mood, energy, connection, and intensity
Score notes offline with word lists
extras: Runs locally on desktop, Android, and iOS; Groq analysis is optional and requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later with a Groq API key (desktop also supports GROQ_API_KEY). Offline scoring uses Morning Pages word lists. Can be installed on mobile via BRAT. Requires Obsidian 1.5 or later. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track and visualize mood trends across dated journal notes over time.

relations.evidence: Enabling Groq sends cleaned text from eligible notes to Groq.

summary: Mood history dashboard that analyzes mood, energy, connection, and intensity across dated notes, with optional Groq analysis.
